releaseNotes:
• Live Match & Tournament Sync: Real-time slot management, credentials verification, and interactive home header
• Native Notifications Engine: Push messaging integration and dedicated notification center
• Haptic Feedback & Gesture Control: Tactile feedback across interactive buttons, cards, and bottom navigation
• In-App Update Experience: Streamlined update panel with live download and install progress
• Unified Payment Flow: Fast UPI QR generation and instant automated wallet settlement
• Theme & UI Refinements: Apple-inspired glassmorphism styling, floating navigation, and dark/light mode polish
